name: debruijn-newman-chladni-evolution
title: Heat-Flow PDE Hierarchy on Jensen Invariants, Nodal-Curvature Zero Velocity, and Conditional Saddle Perturbation under De Bruijn-Newman Evolution
core_theorems: Proposition 2.1: Nodal-curvature interpretation of the Csordas-Smith-Varga and Rodgers-Tao zero velocity (tau = t_DBN)
Proposition 3.1: Mirror Gaussian Wigner factorization and boundary root G_{0,tau}(i*eta) = 0 at 2*eta_0 < pi/4
Proposition 3.2: Conditional perturbation of a local pitchfork saddle under explicit numerator positivity
Theorem 4.1: Second-order radial wave-heat PDE and exact heat-flow PDE hierarchy on Jensen-Laguerre invariants
Corollary 4.3: Exact (m-1)^2/2 multiple-zero coalescence lift and conditional Lehmer-pair scaling in tau = t_DBN
